input.query:
-- Account activation speed and retention analysis
WITH account_activation AS (
    SELECT 
        a.account_id,
        a.created_at as account_created,
        MIN(e.occurred_at) as first_activity,
        DATE_PART('day', MIN(e.occurred_at) - a.created_at) as days_to_activate
    FROM accounts a
    JOIN events e ON a.account_id = e.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.created_at
),
activation_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        aa.account_id,
        aa.days_to_activate,
        CASE 
            WHEN aa.days_to_activate <= 7 THEN 'Quick Activator (<=7 days)'
            WHEN aa.days_to_activate <= 30 THEN 'Moderate Activator (8-30 days)'
            ELSE 'Slow Activator (>30 days)'
        END as activation_group,
        s.status as subscription_status,
        s.end_date
    FROM account_activation aa
    JOIN subscriptions s ON aa.account_id = s.account_id
    WHERE s.status IN ('active', 'churned')
)
SELECT 
    activation_group,
    subscription_status,
    COUNT(*) as accounts,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY activation_group), 1) as pct_within_group
FROM activation_groups
GROUP BY activation_group, subscription_status
ORDER BY activation_group, subscription_status
